title_zh: 商定以请愿要求复议图书馆关闭决定

scenario.label_zh: 商定以请愿要求复议图书馆关闭决定
scenario.goal_zh: 拒绝把愤怒居民一概称为暴民，并确定请愿目标是要求复议而非宣称决定已推翻

context_zh: 公民沟通课的两位成人学员模拟讨论虚构市议会的图书馆关闭决定。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: There’s real outrage about the library closure. I want our petition to ask the council to overturn the decision.

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: So do I, but this draft calls everyone at last night’s meeting a mob. Most people just asked questions.

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: You’re right. Anger doesn’t mean the whole room was violent. I’ll remove that description.

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: And signing a petition won’t itself reverse the decision. Let’s say we’re requesting a fresh vote.

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: Yes. We’ll explain why residents need the library and ask the council to reconsider.

sentences.speaker: Samir
sentences.text: That gives people a clear request to support without pretending we’ve already won.
